message:
The other day, I was trying to show my granddaughter a family recipe on my phone. Just as I was about to hit ‘play,’ the battery died! I’ve had that phone for ages, and of course, I hadn't charged it before our little cooking session. We ended up having a good laugh at my expense, but it got me thinking about how reliant we can be on our devices.

It made me realize how important it is to have backup plans in place, whether it’s printed copies of important documents or a go-bag ready for unexpected moments. Sometimes the simplest things can be the most helpful. Have you ever found yourself in a situation where tech let you down?
